children: Aperture AC signed multiple definitive agreements to combine with Atlantic HPC Group, re-domicile to Delaware, and list the combined company. The Business Combination Agreement provides $150 million in stock consideration valued at $10 per share and up to 6 million earnout shares tied to lease and share-price milestones over five years. To increase closing certainty and trading stability, the parties executed a company holder voting pact, a sponsor support and waiver agreement, lock-up agreements, non-compete agreements with key principals, and an insider letter amendment easing a portion of transfer restrictions at closing. Closing remains subject to shareholder approvals, regulatory clearances, and other customary conditions.
